forge_diamond: unsigned forge_diamond(unsigned a, unsigned b) { volatile unsigned x; if (a > b) x = a + 3; else x = b - 2; return x + 1; }
forge_loop: unsigned forge_loop(unsigned n) { unsigned x = 0; while (n) { x = x * 3 + n; --n; } return x; }
forge_indirect_call: unsigned forge_indirect_call(unsigned (*fn)(unsigned), unsigned a) { return fn(a) + 1; }
